name: Dark Forest Theory
description: Describe the Fermi Paradox, then explain why the Dark Forest Hypothesis is a possible solution.
concepts:
Start with an analogy which symbolically represents the theory: a hunter prowls through the woods with a silent, eerie atmosphere. He happens upon some prey - another human whistling pleasantly as he hikes through the forest. the hunter raises his rifle takes a minute to steady himself, then a shot rings out. the hunter collapses to the ground, slain by another hunter with far better technology (a guillie suit). The hiker looks about, confused, then continues on his way as the second hunter now raises his rifle at the hiker and the scene ends.

then cycle between images of either cosmic darkness, or sci-fi inter-species warfare of spaceships attacking each other. the dialogue here focuses on explaining the fermi paradox, and the dark forest theory.

Then, we show images of human advancements as we colonize the solar systems, showing ships making landing on familiar plannets like mars or one of jupyter's moons with jupyter in the background, or human ships taking off outside of the solar system into the galaxy at large. the dialogue here recaps the efforts humans have made to make contact with alien species. make the tone ominous, and conclude with a warning about how humanity may be making a fatal mistake to end our civilization.
